subject: Next actual support unit: first-vertex through additive render parameters
body: Lowering now confirms existing Valhall primitive.base_vertex_offset can preserve nonzero vertexStart with both attributes and VertexIndex, without a new shader compile path. Consider implementing this coherent cross-owner unit while v2 sidecar API is still being designed: textures owns additive render parameter field and n2r sets primitive.base_vertex_offset; compute owns n2mb_draw_v2 transport plus any additive Dispatch snapshot field/cleanup; render snapshots actual start/bias and keeps attribute base at original bound offset, never rebases twice. Keep old n2mb_draw/n2r_build/defaultoffset0 bytes unchanged. Do not change generic_job_ui.h ownership or use its reserved bytes. Need owner ACKs and tests range/negative bias, original uint16/32 indices, nonzero first vertex+attributes+vertexID. This is a genuine support addition; logged draw omission is not. Instancing/base_instance remains separate.
